assertions.name: k_star_search_completed
assertions.source: Computed FR projector character χ^λ(e_K) for 9 candidate knots × 3 curvature-ranks × 3 atomic-braid ambient algebras (H_6, H_9, H_12). Top candidates per (n, k) ranked by |Z_norm| of the FR-restricted weight.

description: Phase 5d.5: empirical search for the depth-stratified Frobenius-reciprocity candidate knots K_1^*, K_2^* (per depth-stratified-frobenius-reciprocity.md). For each candidate knot K and each curvature-rank k ∈ {1, 2, 3}, compute the FR-restricted weight w̃_λ^(K) at q_0 over the depth-k partitions of n=12 (⁴He). Reports the (K_1^*, K_2^*) pair minimizing the implied 1.82× variance from PR #801.
